variants.name: Saving
variants.summary: While the save is in flight: the whole fieldset is disabled, Cancel is disabled and Save shows its loading state.

variants.name: SavePerGroup
variants.summary: A settings page split into topic groups that each save on their own: the platform shell, a page heading, then one section per topic, each a small heading over a flush `Card` of `Item` rows whose footer carries a secondary Save for that group only. Saving one group disables just its own fieldset; the other stays editable. Preferences is the example, with General (Full Name, Language) and Notifications (Product updates, Security alerts). Built from `PageHeader`, `SettingRow`, the platform shell, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch` and `Button`.

variants.name: SavingOneGroup
variants.summary: General is saving: its Save shows the loading state and its rows are disabled, while Notifications stays editable and can be saved on its own.

variants.name: SavePerCard
variants.summary: A long configuration page split into titled cards that each own their save: the platform shell, a page heading, then one `Card` per topic with an info `Alert`, stacked label-and-control fields inside a fieldset, and a footer whose secondary Save commits that card alone, beside an optional docs `Link`. Project Settings is the example, with Preview Toolbar and Deployment Protection. Built from `PageHeader`, the platform shell, `Card`, `Alert`, `Label`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Link` and `Button`.

variants.name: SavingOneCard
variants.summary: Preview Toolbar is saving: its Save shows the loading state and its selects are disabled, while Deployment Protection stays editable.
